# Selected identity

The Exception (01 from the original twenty-option exploration), selected November 16, 2026.

The raster mark comes from imagegen. Production files preserve its geometry; the existing Atkinson Hyperlegible lettering is retained. SVG lockups and compatibility wrappers embed the PNG mark, rather than redrawing it.

Use the monochrome white mark for adaptive broadcast overlays. Star-textured avatars remain for public profiles.
